headline: Update in one click.
notes: Press Update on the update notice and Trace+ downloads the new version; Creative Cloud asks once to replace the current one, and the plugin reloads. No file to find
Clicking an unused span brings the Source Monitor to the front, even when that clip is already open in it
The unused spans no longer have their own Source Monitor button. Click the row instead: it does the same thing
The hidden-rows button now matches the other filter buttons, and reads "2 hidden" rather than "2hidden"
Less space between a clip's name and the used and never used boxes under it
The Filters menu only offers what applies to the view you are in, so Show / hide eye is gone from the clip view
The first tip of the tour is shorter
